prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1007; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good afternoon. This is the adjuster following up on your claim. This call is being recorded. Do you consent to the recording?

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Thank you. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was on a multi-lane road in Baytown, Texas. I was in the right lane and wanted to move over to the left to make my exit.

Q: What did you do before changing lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my left shoulder. I didn't see anything right beside me, so I signaled and started to move over.

Q: Then what happened?

A: About halfway into the lane change, I heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed toward the median. The other vehicle had been in my blind spot, and we sideswiped each other.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: No. I only saw it after we made contact. It was already alongside me.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I put my left hand out to brace myself against the steering wheel and the airbag, and my wrist took the impact. The doctor later said it's fractured.

Q: Have you received medical treatment?

A: I was taken to the emergency room, and they put me in a splint. I have a follow-up with an orthopedic specialist next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was trying to change lanes safely. I'm still dealing with the pain and I can't drive comfortably right now.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
